evidence_contract: Independent named BEAM operating-system processes; fsynced effects before a file barrier; confirmed OS death; committed database rows establish terminal state. Oban results alone do not count as a paired Grind run.

scenarios.reason: Configured Oban Lifeline automatically rescues aged executing jobs. Grind quarantines an expired ambiguous attempt and requires attributed AuthorizeReplay before another effect.
scenarios.activation: SIGKILL the VM after its fsynced effect, before handler return or acknowledgement.

scenarios.reason: Oban Database Peer elects one maintenance leader and Pruner checks leadership. Grind has no leader; concurrent node-local pruning uses SKIP LOCKED. These fixtures validate different maintenance architectures rather than equal election behavior.
scenarios.activation: Witness old leader maintenance, SIGKILL that VM, then wait for genuine peer lease expiration and survivor maintenance.
